## Overview

<!--
What does this PR do, and why? A sentence or two of context, then whatever
detail a reviewer needs to judge it.

When the change affects behavior a game can observe, show it - a short Ghost
snippet and what it produces, before and after, says more than a paragraph of
description. When the change is internal (engine architecture, performance,
tooling), a short Go snippet or a pasted terminal/error output works the same
way.

A bug fix, shown rather than described:

    canvas.setColor(color.rgb(255, 0, 0, 2))
    // before: silently clamped, no way to know the call was wrong
    // after:  argument error - `color.rgb()` expects an alpha between 0 and 1

A new method:

    sprite.getDimensions()   // [64, 32]
-->
